question: What café can I find inside 180 kilometers as I approach KALEID Gallery, San Jose, CA from Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.886727 37.331306)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, 180000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
